acceptance: ConnectorFrameworkService exposes a bounded STATUS_SYNC execution path for connectors that support polling.
Flipkart syncSubmissionStatus polls the provider with the published SKU and maps provider states into connector submission statuses.
Marketplace submissions can be manually synced through the submissions API without introducing a new queue or scheduler path.
A full integration proof covers live publish initiation followed by manual provider-backed status sync to a terminal submission state.

stories.title: Automatically requeue pending Flipkart submissions for provider-backed status resolution
acceptance: Pending Flipkart connector submissions schedule a bounded delayed status-sync job immediately after live publish initiation.
The existing connector-submission queue can execute both export-job work and connector status-sync work without introducing a new queue or scheduler.
Automatic Flipkart status resolution reuses the published submission SKU lookup and updates connector_submissions to a terminal state without manual intervention.
Worker backpressure validation still passes after delayed queue support is added to the shared queue service.

stories.title: Support Flipkart credential capture and validation through the normal connector install flow
acceptance: Flipkart installs can optionally capture client ID, client secret, and refresh token through the normal connector install endpoint without changing other connector install contracts.
Supplied Flipkart credentials are encrypted on write and validated before the install returns success.
Invalid supplied Flipkart credentials fail the install cleanly and do not leave connector_installations or connector_credentials artifacts behind.
The connectors page renders masked Flipkart credential fields and surfaces install-time validation failures without exposing secrets.
Existing Flipkart publish and status-sync proofs still pass after the install flow gains credential capture.

stories.title: Retry live Flipkart submissions through the connector update path
Add workspace-scoped login with tenant directory resolution
acceptance: Login requires a workspace slug in addition to user ID and password.
Workspace slug resolves to tenantId server-side before credentials are validated.
JWT/session claim shape, cookie names, tenant middleware, and downstream tenant-scoped queries remain unchanged.
Lockout and resend-unlock flows are scoped by workspaceSlug plus userId.
Platform admin can provision tenant workspace slugs through an API-only surface.

stories.title: Prevent empty-body connector revoke requests from sending JSON content-type
acceptance: DELETE requests without a body do not send a default application/json content type.
Connector permission revoke no longer fails with Body cannot be empty when content-type is set to application/json.
The shared deleteJson helper remains available to connector access and template delete flows.

increments.name: Connector Access Validation and Admin UX

stories.title: Validate connector grant principals and clarify admin permission UX
stories.reopened_reason: Fix connector definitions endpoint regression causing /channels/mappings to fail with a 500 when install action matrices are resolved.
stories.regression_evidence: Exact failing command: $login = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/auth/login' -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{workspaceSlug='default'; userId='admin@pim1.local'; password='pim1-demo-password'} | ConvertTo-Json); $headers=@{ Authorization = "Bearer $($login.accessToken)" }; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/connectors/definitions' -Headers $headers -ErrorAction Stop. Failing output snippet: DEFINITIONS_STATUS=500 and backend stack shows PrismaClientKnownRequestError P2037: Too many database connections opened during ConnectorPermissionService.buildDefinitionActions -> PlanUsageService.checkLimit/recomputeUsage. Likely files: apps/api/src/connector-installer/connector-installer.service.ts, apps/api/src/connector-installer/connector-permission.service.ts, apps/api/src/billing/plan-usage.service.ts.
acceptance: Role-based connector grants reject invalid role identifiers server-side.
User-based connector grants reject user IDs that are not present in the current workspace.
Connector Access form uses a role dropdown for role grants and explains that one row applies to one role or one user.
Account alias wildcard behavior is explicit in the admin form and current permissions table.
Connector access validation and entitlement tests pass with workspace-scoped login.
tests_passed: GET /channels/mappings -> 200 after web login in running app

stories.title: Restructure the mappings workspace into a task-first seller workflow
acceptance: Mappings page uses a task-first workflow header with explicit publish context and step guidance.
Mapping editor defaults to missing required fields first while mapped and optional rows are demoted behind collapsed sections.
Version history and publish readiness are anchored as explicit workflow steps without changing lifecycle behavior.
Resolved snapshot and advanced JSON remain available but are no longer the dominant default view.
Existing mapping lifecycle, structured editor, and step-up UI tests remain green.

stories.title: Suppress extension-driven hydration mismatches on shared form controls
stories.reopened_reason: Catalog Categories emitted a hydration mismatch when browser extensions injected data-np-* attributes onto the create-category form and shared input/select controls.
stories.regression_evidence: Exact failing UI error: A tree hydrated but some attributes of the server rendered HTML did not match the client properties. Failing output snippet included data-np-autofill-form-type, data-np-watching, and data-np-checked attributes on the create-category form and inputs. Likely files: apps/web/src/components/ui/input.tsx, apps/web/src/components/ui/select.tsx, apps/web/src/app/catalog/categories/page.tsx.
acceptance: Shared Input and Select primitives suppress hydration warnings caused by extension-injected autofill attributes.
The Catalog Categories create form suppresses hydration warnings at the form boundary.
Web lint and build remain green after the fix.

increments.name: Product Test Architecture and UI UX Acceptance

stories.title: Reorganize current PIM1 tests into product-facing acceptance suites with UI UX coverage
acceptance: PIM1 exposes product-oriented test suite entry points for shell, catalog, publish, operations, governance, and UI UX validation.
The product shell has explicit UI UX acceptance coverage for current topbar and sidebar affordances.
The full product suite passes against the current workspace-scoped login model and current PIM1 feature set.
A committed test strategy document maps product capabilities to the maintained suite entry points.

stories.title: Expose product and category delete UI with safeguards
acceptance: Product list exposes a soft delete action with confirmation for editor/admin roles.
Product detail exposes soft delete and admin-only hard delete with typed confirmation.
Category delete is only enabled when there are no child categories or attached products.
Reviewer role cannot delete products or categories.
Delete actions use existing API endpoints without new backend logic.

increments.name: Playwright E2E Coverage and Workflow Stabilization

stories.title: Add Playwright browser coverage for current PIM1 user workflows
acceptance: Playwright can start isolated API and web test servers against the current workspace-scoped login model.
Browser E2E coverage exists for workspace login, product archive/category delete UI, reviewer approval decisions, and notification center behavior.
Shared web helpers tolerate empty successful responses and do not swallow successful redirect control flow during server actions.
The full Playwright suite passes on current PIM1 behavior.
Playwright runtime logs do not pollute the working tree.

stories.title: Optimize backend readiness, queue, taxonomy rename, and search over-fetch
acceptance: Batch readiness pre-resolves shared mapping context instead of simulating products?channels fully in parallel.
BullMQ enqueue policy applies retries/backoff and connector-aware lane concurrency defaults.
Category rename updates the full subtree inside one transaction without recursive per-child slug probes.
Catalog search reduces over-fetch and only returns the best matching SKU context per product.

stories.title: Remove product detail fetch waterfall and lazy-load secondary mapping panels
acceptance: Product detail starts independent fetches before awaiting product-specific data.
Mappings first render only loads task-critical editor state.
Resolved snapshot, version history, and secondary panels load on demand instead of first paint.
No user-facing mapping or product detail behavior regresses.

stories.title: Add additive slim projections and default pagination for catalog, taxonomy, and export jobs
acceptance: Catalog products listing supports additive slim projection with default limit 50 while preserving the legacy full payload path.
Taxonomy categories default to paginated responses with an explicit all=true full-tree bypass.
Marketplace export job lists support additive templateSummary projection while preserving full template payload for legacy callers.
Internal callers are updated to the additive flags without breaking current product or E2E suites.

stories.title: Add admin audit explorer with filters and CSV export
acceptance: Admin users can filter audit events by actor, action, entity type, and date range.
Non-admin roles are denied access to audit explorer data and CSV export.
Audit explorer supports cursor-based pagination and CSV export without changing existing audit log write behaviour.
Audit explorer passes API, UI, product-suite, and Playwright validation.

stories.title: Serve warm billing usage reads from cached PlanUsage rows and refresh on connector mutations
stories.reopened_reason: Warm staging billing usage reads remain a top steady-state hotspot and need a tighter composite read path.
acceptance: Billing usage reads return the current-month PlanUsage row without recomputing when the row is fresh.
Billing usage recomputes and rewrites the PlanUsage row when the cached row is missing or older than the bounded TTL.
Connector install, disable, and delete paths refresh PlanUsage immediately so billing usage remains accurate after mutations.
Dashboard aggregation and connector entitlement integrations continue to pass with the cached read path.
